$comment: Golden queries of D86 (docs/specs/search.md section 5). where: top (first overall), top3, first-object (first AL object page), first-symbol (first field, event, procedure or value), none (no hits), any; an array means all of them. Extra checks: not_above (no hit whose path contains one of these ranks above the expected one), major (the first hit is present in that major), name/kind (the first symbol's name and kind), within (that record is among the first n symbols), hint (a regular expression one hint must match), hint_path (a hint links that page). pending rows are skipped by the runners until that phase lands.
